subject: Concession request for Optimo launch — multimodel support delay
body:
From: Evan Ruiz <evan.ruiz@optimodynamics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@optimodynamics.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: concession for delayed multimodel support impacting Optimo launch

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We appreciate the responsiveness from the Redwood team. Unfortunately the multimodel routing capability we were counting on (ability to route embeddings + classifier model combo) is now slipping to an early-December ETA due to a kernel integration regression you mentioned. That puts our platform launch at risk — our customers expect the combined flow on day one.

Optimo is requesting a commercial concession to cover the impact to our launch marketing and initial usage: specifically, a one-time credit equal to 30% of our first-month committed invoice or an equivalent discounted rate for the first 3 months. We need this in writing by COB Friday to finalize our internal launch commitments.

Attached: Optimo_SOW_v3.pdf, optimo_usage_snapshot.png (current monthly run-rate).

Can you confirm if Redwood is able to provide an exec-approved concession at that level, or whether there is an alternate make-good you can offer?

Best,
Evan Ruiz
Head of Partnerships
Optimo Analytics

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, connor.obrien@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: concession for delayed multimodel support impacting Optimo launch

Team — forwarding Optimo's ask. Key facts: they want a one-time credit ~30% of first-month committed invoice or 3 months discounted rate. We need an internal decision and exec approval if > $50k. Deal: OPT-3421.

Options for quick discussion:
- One-time invoice credit (percent-based) — simplest to track, immediate goodwill.
- Time-limited discounted dedicated capacity (e.g., 50% off dedicated unit pricing for 3 months) — operationally heavier but preserves ARR.
- Extended support + priority roadmap visibility (no immediate credit) — lower cost to us but may not satisfy procurement.

Connor: can you confirm revenue/finance impact for 25% vs 30% credit? Marcus: we will need your signoff for any concession > $50k. Grace: product ETA for multimodel and likelihood of moving earlier if we prioritize Optimo?

I plan to propose a conditional offer to Evan by Thurs that ties the concession to an executed updated SOW. Thoughts/fast replies appreciated — Optimo needs confirmation by COB Friday.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced: Optimo_SOW_v3.pdf]

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: concession for delayed multimodel support impacting Optimo launch

Rachel — thanks for flagging. My initial take: we can approve a one-time operational credit equal to 25% of the first invoice for a mid-market deal like this, subject to Marcus confirming financials. That hits the goodwill ask without fully setting a 30% precedent.

If Optimo pushes back, we can escalate to a 30% exec exception but require a short co-marketing commitment (joint case study + launch webinar) and an updated SOW signed within 10 business days.

Happy to be on the call with Evan if we need to negotiate.

-Lauren
VP, Sales Operations

---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: concession for delayed multimodel support impacting Optimo launch

Quick numbers: if we do a 25% one-time credit on their first committed invoice (SOW line item is $120k first month committed), that is ~$30k revenue impact — within manager approval. 30% would be $36k. Marcus, can you confirm any other constraints (contract thresholds, accounting treatment)?

Product note (Grace, can you confirm): is there any chance we can fast-track a limited multimodel routing patch for Optimo before their launch? If we can provide a targeted mitigation (short-term adapter) that lowers the concession required, it's the best outcome.

Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager

> On Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 08:55 Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
>
> Rachel/Connor — short answer: full multimodel routing general availability is still targeted for early December. The regression is with a kernel optimization when routing two distinct model classes; the team is running a narrowfix branch but there's nontrivial QA.
>
> We can probably ship a limited adapter for Optimo (routing rule + manual fallback) within 7–10 business days if we prioritize it, but that requires product resources and will push other smaller tickets. If Optimo accepts a limited scoped workaround (documented limitations + SLA), it might remove the need for a commercial concession.
>
> Grace
> Product Manager, Serving Runtime

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Ruiz <evan.ruiz@optimodynamics.com>, Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@optimodynamics.com>
Cc: procurement@optimodynamics.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: concession for delayed multimodel support impacting Optimo launch

Evan / Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the SOW. I ran this up the chain and coordinated with Sales Ops, CS, Product, and Finance. Here is the conditional offer Redwood can make: 

1) Commercial: one-time credit equal to 20% of the first-month committed invoice (based on the SOW committed line items). This is an exception we can approve at my level; Marcus will sign the finance acknowledgement once the SOW is updated.

2) Service: we will prioritize a scoped multimodel adapter for Optimo (routing + fallback) and aim to deliver the adapter within 10 business days. This adapter will be provided with documented limitations and a short-term SLA.

3) Terms: the concession is contingent on an executed SOW amendment (DocuSign link below) that confirms the committed volumes and the 3-month monitoring period. For the larger concession level (30%) we discussed internally, we could consider that in exchange for a joint marketing commitment and an extended 6-month payment guarantee, but that needs exec-level signoff and longer negotiation.

Please sign the attached updated SOW via DocuSign by EOD Friday so we can move forward. Once signed, Marcus will process the credit and Finance will reflect it on the first invoice.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/XYZ-Optimo-SOW
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/OPT-3421

Appreciate the partnership — we want Optimo’s launch to succeed and will do what we can inside the guardrails. Happy to hop on a call if you'd like to go through the adapter scope.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

[Attachments sent: Optimo_SOW_v3.pdf, optimo_usage_snapshot.png]
